title.vi: Hàm cửa sổ (2): xếp hạng, top-N mỗi nhóm, khử trùng và phân vị
title.en: Window functions (2): ranking, top-N per group, de-duplication and quantiles

summary.vi: ROW_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE_RANK, NTILE, PERCENT_RANK, mẫu top-N
summary.en: ROW_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE_RANK, NTILE, PERCENT_RANK, the top-N pattern

files.name: query.sql
files.code:
-- Top 2 lương cao nhất MỖI phòng ban
SELECT name, department_id, salary
FROM (
  SELECT name, department_id, salary,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY salary DESC) AS rn
  FROM employees
  WHERE department_id IS NOT NULL
)
WHERE rn <= 2
ORDER BY department_id, rn;

-- Chia lương thành 4 nhóm phân vị
SELECT name, salary, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC) AS quartile FROM employees ORDER BY salary DESC;

prompt.vi: Với mỗi phòng ban (bỏ người chưa có phòng), lấy 2 nhân viên lương cao nhất: trả về name, department_id, salary, sắp xếp theo department_id rồi salary giảm dần. Dùng ROW_NUMBER trong truy vấn con.
prompt.en: For each department (skip people without one), take the 2 highest-paid employees: return name, department_id, salary, sorted by department_id then salary descending. Use ROW_NUMBER in a subquery.

hint.vi: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY salary DESC) AS rn rồi WHERE rn <= 2.
hint.en: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY salary DESC) AS rn then WHERE rn <= 2.

prompt.vi: Dùng NTILE(2) chia nhân viên theo lương giảm dần thành 2 nửa: trả về name và nửa (cột half), sắp xếp theo lương giảm dần rồi name.
prompt.en: Use NTILE(2) to split employees by salary descending into 2 halves: return name and the half (column half), sorted by salary descending then name.

hint.vi: NTILE(2) OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC) AS half.
hint.en: NTILE(2) OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC) AS half.
